featured_reviews.name: Vishal Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stay away and AVOID at all costs!!

The owner, Aasumi, and her brother are the co-owners of the business. They will never answer your phone calls. In the three months of communication I had with her, neither she nor her brother ever picked up a phone call. Aasumi is the person I dealt with. She only responds via messages or WhatsApp voice notes.

She expected my uncle, who is from Mumbai and in his mid-70s, to understand and reply using voice notes. When I challenged her about this, she said her parents are in their 70s and know how to leave voice notes.

She is very clever — she uses one number for clients and a different number for staff. This allows her to send voice notes and messages to clients without answering their calls if there is an issue. However, her staff have a different number through which they can contact her via voice call, which apparently is not shared with clients.

She was very difficult to work with. When we asked for a long-term stay discount, she initially refused, then later agreed to give a discount if we paid in cash. We paid her in cash.

During our stay, when it became increasingly difficult to get hold of her, we asked her caretakers (staff) to contact her on our behalf. She would then become angry and send long WhatsApp messages and voice notes asking why we went through her caretakers instead of contacting her directly. She used illness as an excuse, but her brother could have returned my calls. I called her brother 10 times in January 2026, and he never returned or acknowledged any of my calls.

Lastly, she was very difficult when it came to returning the deposit. She initially said she would return it at check-out via her caretaker. The caretaker was unaware of this arrangement. She then said she would return it the following day and asked for our bank details. Later, when confronted, she said it usually takes seven working days to process a bank transfer, as stated in the booking terms. However, she did not check the original method of payment. When she wants payment, she sends frequent reminders and strict policies, but she is very slow in returning money.

She eventually returned the deposit after five working days (which is within the stated seven working days), but only after repeated messaging and several changes to her story.

There is a major communication issue, and I do not recommend using this company. The apartment in DN Nagar Platinum One was acceptable — compact, cleaned daily, and served its purpose. However, the poor communication, her attitude, and lack of professionalism in guest relations make this an option I would absolutely avoid in the future.

​The Hospitality
​What truly sets Bliss Serviced Apartments  is the host. From the moment I checked in, the hospitality was top-notch. The host was:
​Attentive: Always available to answer questions and went above and beyond to ensure I had everything I needed.

​Reliable: Any small request I had was handled instantly with a smile.
​Final Verdict
​Whether you are looking for a short getaway or a long-term stay like mine, I cannot recommend this place enough. The combination of a beautiful, well-maintained 2 BHK and a world-class host makes this the best choice in the area.
​Thank you, Bliss Serviced Apartments, for making my 16-day stay so memorable. I will definitely be returning!
